title: Turkish-Style Doner Kebab
description: A traditional Turkish dish made with thinly sliced lamb, served in a crispy sesame-topped bun.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of leg and shoulder for best results

ingredients.name: Turkish Bread
ingredients.notes: Also known as Simit, use a crusty bread with sesame seeds

ingredients.name: Lettuce
ingredients.notes: Use fresh lettuce leaves for garnish

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Use ripe tomatoes for best flavor

ingredients.name: Red Onion
ingredients.notes: Use thinly sliced red onion for added flavor

ingredients.name: Mayonnaise
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting mayonnaise for best results

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for best flavor

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Use sweet paprika for added flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use coarse salt for best results

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for best flavor

instructions: Slice the lamb into thin strips, about 1/4 inch thick.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the lamb mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the Turkish bread by grilling it for a few minutes on each side.
Assemble the kebabs by placing a few slices of the lamb onto each bread bun.
Top each kebab with a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, a few slices of red onion, and a dollop of mayonnaise.
Note: You can also cook the lamb on a grill or in a skillet on the stovetop if preferred.
